videos.title: HOME | A film about my grandparents | KRNBRY Studio
videos.description:
My grandfather was scared the first time he saw a car. He went on to finish his PhD in Hawaii, having grown up in a small village in rural Nepal. 

HOME is a spoken word documentary about my grandparents, Muktinath Khanal, Devidutta Paudyal and Sarita Paudyal. I sat down with each of them in Nepal and asked about the lives they lived before I knew them. A lawyer and journalist who still fills note

videos.description:
Welcome to the 60 Second Thrift Challenge! 

A KRNBRY Studio original production where contestants blindly choose one of three mystery themes. Their challenge? Find a fit that matches the theme in just 60 seconds. Then comes the reveal, and YOU decide: did they nail it or fail it? 👀
